info.title: Model Request Bindings
info.description: Explicit, non-secret request metadata resolved from the authenticated caller's reported Runtime KV.

ModelRequestBindings.description: Optional OpenAITenantModelProviderData.request_bindings metadata. Omitted or empty disables Runtime reads. Supported only for openai-tenant LLM GenerateStream and Invoke. Values never select resources or credentials.

required.description: Missing or JSON null fails a required binding; an optional binding omits the header. Present invalid values always fail. No implicit value defaults or stale fallback.

name.description: Business extension header. Authentication, forwarding and SDK control headers are reserved. Names are unique ignoring case. Resolved values must be nonempty printable ASCII without surrounding spaces, at most 1024 bytes; all injected header lines together are at most 8192 bytes.

ModelRequestSource.description: Variable source selected by exactly one named branch. Only peer_runtime_kv is currently supported.

key.description: Exact key in the authenticated invoking Peer's device-reported Runtime KV, at most 64 UTF-8 bytes. The Peer is always the authenticated caller, never a configurable selector. Do not report secrets.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer within the key's JSON value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes and 16 segments. Omitted or empty selects the whole value. No fragments, wildcards or expressions. The selected header value must be a JSON string.

ModelRequestPeerRuntimeKVSelector.description: Locates a value in the authenticated invoking Peer's device-reported Runtime KV.
